blocks.text: Kris Aquino shared a hilarious encounter with a doctor whom she—while under anesthesia—asked for a kiss on the lips during a medical procedure. “I will not name the doctor and this is not the doctor who was my boyfriend. This is a very well respected doctor,” she shared during her TV reunion with her close friend Boy Abunda on “Fast Talk with Boy Abunda” on Wednesday, Oct. 28. “Kasi nabigyan na ako ng anesthesia pero hindi pa ‘yung todo so medyo gising-gising pa ako.
